title: Web fleet board
goal: Web users in branch mode see a live fleet board with one card per agent: owner colour, branch, state, locks and merge actions, ordered so the agents that need a human come first.
scope_in: Route `/s/:sessionId/fleet` in apps/web/src/fleet/ rendering agent cards (DESIGN.md 10.2.3 Agent card): colour dot + initial, branch (middle-truncated), state text + glyph, elapsed time, 36 px mascot thumbnail for the running state, `glow-signal` for the running card only.
Data from `agent.spawn`, `agent.state`, `agent.exit`, `branch.update`, `file.lock`, `conflict.detected`, `diff.share` via the shared reducer (C076/C062).
Sort 'needs you first' (awaiting-approval, asking-question, merge-conflict, errors) following DESIGN.md 11.2 priority; filters by owner and state; compact density table view (28 px rows).
Branch graph summary per card: ahead/behind/dirty from `branch.update`; merge action buttons emit callbacks to the host-side owner via normal queue/control paths only (no new events).
Conflict banner and lock list reusing C078's semantics rendered in web components (implemented locally; no TUI import).
scope_out: Terminal fleet panel (C042) and TUI conflict UX (C078).
Executing merges (the owner's client does it).
build_against: Mock backend (lane C007) scripted branch-mode session with 3 agents and lock/conflict events; fixtures from contracts/fixtures/events.
interfaces: export function FleetBoard(props: {agents: AgentView[]; locks: LockView[]; conflicts: ConflictView[]; density: 'comfortable'|'compact'; selfMember: MemberId}): JSX.Element
export function sortAgents(a: AgentView[]): AgentView[]  // DESIGN.md 11.2 priority then owner then spawn time

AgentView = {id: AgentId; owner: MemberId; mode: string; state: StateName|'working'; since: string; label?: string; branch?: string; git?: {head: string; ahead: number; behind: number; dirty: boolean}}
acceptance: With 16 agents (max_parallel_agents team default) the board renders in < 100 ms and only <= 6 mascots animate; the rest pause on first frame (DESIGN.md 19.6).
Cards re-order within one render when an agent enters awaiting-approval; the mascot state obeys the 600 ms minimum dwell and the 3-calls-in-2s collapse rule.
Unknown `agent.state.state` values display as 'working' (thinking class) and are logged at debug.
Each state has a glyph and a word in addition to colour; colour-blind simulation (3 types) test screenshots still distinguish approval, error and running.
Branch names and labels appear only after successful decrypt; before key arrival cards show `Agent 1`-style neutral labels.
Keyboard: Tab order follows visual order, Enter opens inspector, `j`/`k` moves between cards; hit target >= 32 px.
Under reduced motion no mascot animates and the running card has a static signal border (no glow pulse).
tests: fleet.render.test.tsx: 16-card perf and budget on animated mascots.
guardrails: MUST NOT show branch/worktree names or paths in tab titles, URLs or telemetry (they are `ct`-only).
MUST derive mascot from real state only; the mascot never changes state (DESIGN.md 11.4 rule 1).
MUST NOT use `crash`, `glitch`, `panic` animations in reduced-motion mode.
failure_modes: agent.exit with `error_code` unknown -> generic error chip with the word 'Failed'.
Roster does not contain owner yet -> neutral violet-outlined avatar with '?' until roster arrives.
Lock/conflict `path_hmac` without decrypted path -> show hmac prefix label.
notes: Share the pure sorting/priority function with the TUI only through a package if one exists; this lane keeps a local copy to avoid cross-area imports, flagged for later dedupe.
